note: Pin registry, 011-convention. Round 2 found the earlier blanket claim that 'every non-null pin is enforced' was false, so every member is now classified explicitly by `enforcement`: SCORER (compared against the live artefact by harness/score.py before anything is adjudicated; a mismatch is terminal pipeline-invalidity), CI (enforced by the workflow's install steps, not by the scorer), or DESCRIPTIVE (recorded provenance the scorer does not check). Only SCORER members are load-bearing at adjudication time.

cloudflareOs.importNote: The probes import tools.ts, auto-approval.ts, mock-storage.ts and typed-storage/src/index.ts as live code from the pinned clone (never vendored), bundled per invocation by the clone's own esbuild (upstream's vitest path needs a newer glibc than this apparatus provides — same pinned sources either way) and run under the pinned node. overseer.ts supplies the ActionRecord and AutoApproveTagRecord types harness/typecheck.py holds every retained LEDGER RECORD and AUTO-APPROVAL RULE to — that is the whole typechecked surface; staged calls, drain witnesses, catalogs and effect attestations are instrumentation with no upstream type — via the clone's own typescript under the backend package's own tsconfig. cloudflare:workers is aliased to probes/stubs/cloudflare-workers.ts, whose only runtime export used is an inert tracing object — the study's single injected seam, on the observability path only.
cloudflareOs.upstreamCiNode: 22.14.0 (the upstream repository's own CI pin, recorded as context; the harness pin below is what is enforced)
cloudflareOs.backendTypecheckFinding: WITHDRAWN. An earlier draft recorded that binding fixtures to the server-side ActionRecord was not reproducible from the committed tree because the backend needed a wrangler-regenerated worker-configuration.d.ts. That was wrong: the file is tracked at the pin (git ls-files packages/workshop-backend/worker-configuration.d.ts), and `node scripts/build-format-blueprints.mjs` (run from the package directory, as the package's own test script does) followed by tsc -p packages/workshop-backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit exits 0 with zero diagnostics and leaves the tracked tree clean. The gate binds the real server-side type accordingly; see DEVIATIONS.md.
cloudflareOs.runtimeValidationNote: The platform DOES validate at its live RPC boundary: ApprovalQueueImpl carries @validateRpc() (overseer.ts:9428), so submitAction's arguments — including the declared structure of ActionDescription — are checked on arrival by validators generated from the pinned TypeScript types at build time. What it ships no part of is OFFLINE verification of a retained or exported action record: those validators are inline closures inside the built Worker, bound to a live service method, structural only (every semantic commitment is an unconstrained string), and carry no digest or signature. An action-log export of a kind DOES exist — listActions() (api.ts:1422, implemented at overseer.ts:7548) projects the stored records to authorized clients — but it is unsigned, undigested, and strips the fields that would let a holder join to a connector's private store, so what is absent is a SIGNED, COMPLETE, OFFLINE-VERIFIABLE record export. Round 4 (R4-6) found the earlier unqualified 'no action-log export anywhere' false; this is the corrected statement, and the study's load-bearing claim is that last clause and only that.
cloudflareOs.connector: The registered deployment is packages/gatekeeper-mcp-portal with MCP_PORTAL_TRUST_ANNOTATIONS=true. Round 2 established this is forced: the generic MCP connector hardwires `const TRUST: ServerTrust = "byo"` (gatekeeper-mcp/src/mcp.ts:77) with no deployment knob, and classifyTool requires `vetted` for auto-approval (mcp-shared/src/tools.ts:66-69), so a vetted auto-approvable write exists only on the portal (gatekeeper-mcp-portal/src/config.ts:34-36).

studyManifest.covers: every top-level *.md (PREREGISTRATION.md and PREREG-REVIEW.md, once the filter below has run), adapter/SPEC.md, harness/MATRIX.json, harness/MATRIX-HOLDOUT.json, harness/PINS.json, harness/requirements.txt, the vendored pack and conformance-case bytes, every adapter/*.py and harness/*.py (tests included), every probes/*.ts and probes/stubs/*.ts, and every fixtures/**/MANIFEST.sha256 across both strata
studyManifest.excludes: DEVIATIONS.md and README.md, by construction rather than by omission (ADR 0004, make_manifest.EXCLUDED_DOCUMENTS, asserted by a harness test that disables the constant and shows both files enter the manifest). The manifest covers what must not change; DEVIATIONS.md is the one place a post-freeze correction may land, so covering it would make the first genuine deviation break the anchor it exists to protect, and README.md carries a status banner that must be able to change after an attempt runs. Round 6 (R6-7) found the earlier arrangement tautological — no candidate glob reached a top-level .md, so nothing was ever filtered; the candidate population now includes them and the filter is what removes these two.
studyManifest.note: exact-set whole-study manifest; regenerated during drafting, pinned at the freeze. No digest is recorded here because this file is inside the manifest's own coverage

preregistration.note: Filled with the file's digest at the freeze, so a post-freeze edit is detectable. Null until then; the scorer refuses a registered (non-pilot) run while null.
